output.reason: The evidence does not mention any “at least 2%” pre-payment charge requirement by RBI, so that part of the claim (that this assumption is not supported) is not directly evidenced. However, the cited direction does state that a Tier 3 UCB “shall not levy any pre-payment charges” on floating rate loans for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (as defined under the MSMED Act, 2006) where the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh. This supports the idea that, at least in this specified category, pre-payment charges are not levied at all (i.e., not “at least 2%”).
